summary: Audax Private Credit Fund, LLC filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K disclosing periodic valuation metrics rather than any special-situation event. NAV per common share was $24.704 as of July 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of $608.9 million, investment portfolio fair value of $1,160.3 million, and principal debt outstanding of $559.2 million, implying roughly 0.92x debt-to-equity leverage. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing is a business-development-company-style NAV update; watch for subsequent NAV marks, leverage changes, and any distribution or tender-offer announcements.
